tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. White in light; near-black in dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, inputs, the order panel. One step off the page in dark.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table headers, inset areas, footers and the active segment background.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The conversation background, so white customer bubbles still show.

tokens.name: elevated
tokens.usage: Floating things: the selection bar, toasts, popovers. Pair with shadow-float.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers between rows and card edges. Too faint for control borders, on purpose.

tokens.name: line-medium
tokens.usage: Borders on buttons and chips, where the label already identifies the control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders on inputs, checkboxes and selects. 3:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Main text, and the colour of the wordmark.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text the seller still reads: item lists, townships, message previews.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Timestamps, help text, captions. Not for anything the seller has to act on.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Terracotta. The one action colour: main buttons, switches that are on, the selected day. One main button per screen.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Pressed and hover state of primary buttons.

tokens.name: primary-ink
tokens.usage: Terracotta for text: links, the active tab label and marker, the active menu item.

tokens.name: primary-tint
tokens.usage: Background of the active menu item and selected quick picks.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text on primary.

tokens.name: brand-dot
tokens.usage: The full stop in the logo.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Terracotta for text when a word needs the brand colour. Same as primary-ink; kept for existing uses.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring. Blue so it is never confused with terracotta.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Ready to confirm, confirmed.

tokens.name: success-fg
tokens.usage: Text on success-bg.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Waiting on the seller: needs you, low stock. Amber, kept away from terracotta.

tokens.name: warning-fg
tokens.usage: Text on warning-bg.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Something is wrong or stopped: cancelled, sold out, failed to send.

tokens.name: danger-fg
tokens.usage: Text on danger-bg. A cool crimson, so it never reads as terracotta.

tokens.name: danger-solid
tokens.usage: Destructive actions behind a confirm step.

tokens.name: on-danger-solid
tokens.usage: Text on danger-solid.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: In progress, nothing to do yet: to pack, held.

tokens.name: info-fg
tokens.usage: Text on info-bg.

tokens.name: neutral-bg
tokens.usage: Done or quiet: dispatched, Revaro answering.

tokens.name: neutral-fg
tokens.usage: Text on neutral-bg.

tokens.name: bubble-customer
tokens.usage: Customer messages. Pair with bubble-customer-line.

tokens.name: bubble-customer-line
tokens.usage: Outline of customer bubbles.

tokens.name: bubble-revaro
tokens.usage: Revaro's automatic replies. A slate tint: never solid black or solid white.

tokens.name: on-bubble-revaro
tokens.usage: Text in Revaro's bubble.

tokens.name: bubble-seller
tokens.usage: The seller's own replies. A terracotta tint so they never look like Revaro's.

tokens.name: on-bubble-seller
tokens.usage: Text in the seller's bubble.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The dimmed layer behind dialogs and bottom sheets.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The big figures on Home and Orders.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page titles on tablet and desktop.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Phone body text and every input. 16px is the floor for inputs; smaller and iPhones zoom in.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Desktop and tablet body text: tables, lists, panels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Times, help text, table headers. If the seller needs to act on it, it is not a caption.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Prices and counts. Use with tabular-nums so totals line up.

styles.name: body-my
styles.sample: အနက်ရောင် M ကို ၂ နာရီ သိမ်းထားပေးပါမယ်။
styles.usage: Burmese body text. Line height 1.75 so stacked marks don't clip.

styles.name: heading-my
styles.sample: အတည်ပြုရန် အသင့်

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between related controls; between chat bubbles.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside badges and compact rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding and phone side margins.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between cards in the queue.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top of the morning summary.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty states.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small chips inside tables.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, the selection bar.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Chat bubbles and the phone order bar.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills, filter chips, counts.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Buttons and cards. Barely there; the border does the work.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: The order bar fixed at the bottom of the phone chat.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Things that float over the page: the selection bar, toasts, popovers. Always on elevated.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable.

tokens.name: tap-comfort
tokens.usage: Primary actions on phones (Confirm order, Take over).

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of reading pages (Settings, Billing), aligned left beside the navigation.

tokens.name: bubble-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a chat bubble within its column.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar width from 1280px.

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: Icon rail width from 768px to 1279px.
